steps.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: 16:9 game backdrop. Primary request: An enchanted cottage garden at moonrise from a gentle fairy tale, a small warm cottage at far right, a woodland fountain at far left, pink flowers and leafy paper plants around the edges, no people, no cabbage, no text. Style/medium: premium handmade cut-paper collage: layered construction paper, cardstock and felt with visible fibre texture, softly rounded die-cut and scissor-cut edges, slight handmade imperfections, occasional tiny stitched details, and soft tactile shadows between stacked layers; saturated kraft-paper brights on a warm cream field; child-safe toy proportions and handmade warmth. No text, no letters, no words. Composition/framing: wide 4:3 view with a broad uncluttered lower-centre paper stage for a child pose actor, clear sightline between fountain and cottage, no important detail under the upper word row. Lighting/mood: lavender-blue early evening with warm cottage-window light and soft moon glow, safe, funny and wondrous. Constraints: environment only; preserve a clear open floor for separately composited sprites. Avoid: characters, creatures, people, food or loose hero objects in the performance area, text, letters, logo, watermark, UI, border, collage, photorealism, 3D.
